svg.text: Verification lanes, shared codec version, and the bench-to-V2X check
Three clusters belonging to no single node folder.
Delivered first: verification before the code it verifies
Shared codec version and its integrity gate
Bench-to-V2X check: scripted acceptance, executed by CI on every push
The only check exercising the complete application
without a deployed Room. It closes one acceptance
criterion independently, and the same script is
re-executed against a saved log from the live node.
the ADA-side listener prints complete message bodies
